subject.title: fix(logging): keep JSON console output structured across CLI routes

question: Should OpenClaw accept machineOutput as a supported root plugin CLI metadata contract in order to preserve raw stdout while JSON console diagnostics are enabled?
rationale: The logging fix is bounded, but adding this resolver commits the plugin SDK to a new pre-activation command-classification mechanism and changes output routing across several bundled plugins.

options.title: Accept the root metadata contract
options.body: Approve machineOutput as a documented root-only plugin CLI capability and retain the bundled command classifications after the type-check failure is resolved.

options.title: Narrow to core logging
options.body: Land only the shared JSON diagnostic formatting repair now and move plugin machine-output classification to a separately sponsored SDK design.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Hold the PR until owners define long-term plugin CLI output-mode semantics and compatibility expectations.

recommendation.title: Accept the root metadata contract
recommendation.body: Approve machineOutput as a documented root-only plugin CLI capability and retain the bundled command classifications after the type-check failure is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The current integration commit ties the CLI startup boundary, logging contract, and proposed plugin metadata surface together.
